payload.description: With 19 years of experience, the network of 600 loyal customers guarantees first-class products and services, technical support and expertise consulting, as well as time-verified maintenance services. So far, we have served over 400 businesses throughout Moldova. RTI delivers equipment suitable for various sizes and types of companies through its comprehensive range of fixed, mobile devices and state-of-the-art systems. All systems use the best software and can be connected to other programs as needed. The individual configuration of the software facilitates the optimal adjustment of the equipment to the specific requirements of the client. Likewise, all the equipment can be easily interconnected and is suitable for the simultaneous use of fixed and mobile devices, as well as for the extension of the network in the future.
